title: Classify blockers and continue independent ready work
limitations: The classifier distinguishes the eight blocker kinds and names independent ready tasks. It does not start work, admit a repair, signal a process, or write native task status.
A blocked task is rechecked only by an unconsumed admitted probe whose not_before has arrived, or by a changed prerequisite. Heartbeats, logs, pids, attempts and the clock do not qualify.

An admitted probe does not clear a hold, mark unknown effects known, or refund a budget. Exhaustion that did not come from the WWL-100 progress ledger is sticky. When the ledger has the incident, the ledger is the budget authority.
dependency-running waits on live work and is not an idle failure. A campaign hold continues nothing. A task hold does not stop independent ready work.
A software defect requires a reproducer body whose digest equals the receipt. Unknown effects are not relabeled as that defect.

Input aliases accept the watchdog names. rights maps to permission, source_unavailable maps to source-outage, and budget maps to exhausted-budget. Gated input stays separate. HTTP 401, 403 and 429 map to credentials, permission and source-outage. Any other non-success status is refused.
The sealed interpreter /usr/bin/python3.12 does not provide pytest on the authoritative PATH. The blocker suite was executed with the workspace virtualenv that provides pytest 9.1.1.
This receipt does not grant campaign completion or task completion.
